sloka: यथा हि कुर्यात्सर्पो वा शत्रुर्वा प्रत्युपेक्षितः ।राजञा दशरथेनाद्य सपुत्रा त्वं तथा कृता ॥२-७-२८॥
transliteration: yathā hi kuryātsarpo vā śatrurvā pratyupekṣitaḥ ।rājañā daśarathenādya saputrā tvaṁ tathā kṛtā ॥2-7-28॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha has done to you and to your son the same thing as a snake or an enemy would do when ignored.
